LanguageData.VUIP.DefaultsResetTip: Clear all saved pawn, new-game and quest-reward defaults and restore their enable switches.
LanguageData.VUIP.InterfaceResetTip: Restore title-screen, main-bar, resource-readout, colonist-bar, list and table options to their defaults.
LanguageData.VUIP.QuestRewardDefaultsNone: No default quest reward preferences saved yet. Use Set as default in the quest reward preferences window.
LanguageData.VUIP.HudSectionTip: Alerts, letters, date, weather, speed controls, and play buttons on the colony and world map.
LanguageData.VUIP.HudResetTip: Restore HUD options to their defaults. Snooze options live under Notifications and are not affected.
LanguageData.VUIP.CustomNotificationsSectionTip: Alerts added by Vanilla UI+ that are not part of the base game, plus alert snoozing. Each can be turned off individually. These work whether or not the custom HUD is enabled.
LanguageData.VUIP.CustomNotificationsResetTip: Restore custom alerts, vanilla alert changes and snooze options to their defaults. Does not clear existing snoozes.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowBleedingOutAlertTip: Critical alert when a colonist or prisoner will die from blood loss soon (less than about 18 hours at the current bleed rate). Appears in the alert stack.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowHostilesPresentAlertTip: Critical alert when hostiles are on a map with your colonists. Pinned above letters when the custom HUD is on, otherwise it sits in the normal alert stack.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainMenuSectionTip: Changes to the title screen and bottom main menu bar.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainMenuResetTip: Restore main menu options to their defaults.
LanguageData.VUIP.HideTutorialButtonTip: Removes the Tutorial button from the title screen. You can restore it here at any time.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowContinueButtonTip: Adds a Continue button to the title screen when a saved game exists. It loads the most recently updated save using RimWorld's normal version and mod-list checks.
LanguageData.VUIP.OtherSectionTip: Smaller, single-option changes to the colonist bar, Wildlife tab, item filter tabs, pawn tables, and new game setup.
LanguageData.VUIP.OtherResetTip: Restore all options in this section to their defaults.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShiftColonistBarInDevModeTip: The development mode toolbar sits across the top of the screen in the same place as the colonist bar and covers the first row of portraits. This moves the colonist bar down far enough to clear it. Only applies while development mode is on.
LanguageData.VUIP.ColonistBarDevOffsetTip: How far to move the colonist bar down while development mode is on.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowLeatherColumnTip: Adds a column showing the type of leather each animal yields when killed or hunted.
LanguageData.VUIP.CollapseFilterCategoriesTip: Vanilla opens the first item category (usually Food) in every item filter, and a stockpile shows whatever categories were left open on the last one. With this on, every category starts closed at game start, and the storage tab starts fully collapsed each time you select a different stockpile or reopen the tab.
LanguageData.VUIP.FocusStorageSearch: Default to search bar on storage selection
LanguageData.VUIP.FocusStorageSearchTip: Puts the cursor in the storage tab's search box when you select a different stockpile or open the tab, so you can type straight away. Until you click elsewhere or press Escape, typing goes into the box instead of triggering hotkeys.
LanguageData.VUIP.ResizeFilterTabTip: Opens the storage filter tab at a fixed size instead of vanilla's cramped default, so more categories are visible without scrolling.
LanguageData.VUIP.ResourceReadoutSectionTip: The list of resources at the top left of the screen: order, hidden rows, zero counts and counting everything on the map.
LanguageData.VUIP.ResourceReadoutResetTip: Restore resource readout options to their defaults. This also clears the saved order, moved rows, hidden rows and count-all settings.
LanguageData.VUIP.CountHiddenInTotals: Count hidden resources in category totals
LanguageData.VUIP.CountHiddenInTotalsTip: When on, a hidden resource still adds to the total of the category it sits in. When off, category totals only include what is shown.
LanguageData.VUIP.DragToReorderResourcesTip: Click and drag a row in the resource list at the top left to move it. In categorized mode a row can also be dropped into another open category or onto the top level, for example to keep silver at the very top; right-click it to send it back. Simple and categorized modes each remember their own order. This only changes the list, not the item categories used by storage.
LanguageData.VUIP.ResourceRightClickMenuTip: Right-click a row in the resource list for options, including counting everything on the map and hiding rows you don't want to see. While this is on, right-clicking the list no longer passes the click to the map underneath.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowZeroResources: Show resources with a count of zero
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowZeroResourcesTip: Lists every resource the colony could stock, even ones you have none of. Categories that could never hold anything stay hidden.
LanguageData.VUIP.ResourceCountAllOnMapTip: Counts every one of this lying on the map (except under fog), not just what is in storage. On a category, this applies to everything inside it.
LanguageData.VUIP.ResourceCountingAllTip: Counting everything on the map, not just what is in storage.
LanguageData.VUIP.ResourceMoveIntoItself: A category can't be moved inside itself.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShiftClickAssignAreaToAll: Shift-click to assign area to everyone
LanguageData.VUIP.ShiftClickAssignAreaToAllTip: Shift-click any allowed area button (Unrestricted, Home, a named area, ...) for one pawn to assign that same area to every eligible pawn in the table, not just that row.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowShiftScheduleArrowsTip: Adds arrows either side of the Schedule tab's timetable that move a pawn's whole schedule one hour earlier or later, wrapping round midnight. Click an arrow in the header to move everyone's schedule at once.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShiftScheduleEarlierTip: Move this schedule one hour earlier.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShiftScheduleLaterTip: Move this schedule one hour later.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShiftAllSchedulesEarlierTip: Move every schedule in this list one hour earlier.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShiftAllSchedulesLaterTip: Move every schedule in this list one hour later.
LanguageData.VUIP.ApplyDefaultScheduleTip: Adds a pin to the left of each pawn's copy/paste buttons on the Schedule tab. Pin a pawn to make their schedule the default; every pawn that joins your colony afterwards starts with it. The default is shared across all your colonies.
LanguageData.VUIP.DefaultScheduleNone: No default schedule pinned yet. Use the pin on the Schedule tab.
LanguageData.VUIP.SetDefaultScheduleTip: Make this schedule the default for pawns that join the colony.
LanguageData.VUIP.ClearDefaultScheduleTip: This is the default schedule for new pawns. Click to clear it.
LanguageData.VUIP.DefaultScheduleSet: {0}'s schedule is now the default for new pawns.
LanguageData.VUIP.ApplyDefaultWorkPriorities: Default work priorities for new colonists
LanguageData.VUIP.ApplyDefaultWorkPrioritiesTip: Adds a pin to the left of each pawn's copy/paste buttons on the Work tab. Pin a pawn to make their work priorities the default; every colonist or slave who joins your colony afterwards starts with them. Jobs the pinned pawn cannot do are left at the game's normal setting. The default is shared across all your colonies.
LanguageData.VUIP.DefaultWorkPrioritiesNone: No default work priorities pinned yet. Use the pin on the Work tab.
LanguageData.VUIP.SetDefaultWorkPrioritiesTip: Make these work priorities the default for pawns that join the colony.
LanguageData.VUIP.ClearDefaultWorkPrioritiesTip: These are the default work priorities for new pawns. Click to clear them.
LanguageData.VUIP.DefaultWorkPrioritiesSet: {0}'s work priorities are now the default for new pawns.
LanguageData.VUIP.ApplyDefaultAssignmentsTip: Adds a pin on the left of the Assign tab. Pin a pawn to make everything on that row the default: hostility response, medical care, apparel, food, drug and reading policies, and what they carry (including columns other mods add, such as Progression: Ammunition's ammo). Every colonist or slave who joins your colony afterwards starts with it. Policies are matched by name, so a colony without a policy of that name keeps the game's default for it. The default is shared across all your colonies.
LanguageData.VUIP.DefaultAssignmentsNone: No default assignments pinned yet. Use the pin on the Assign tab.
LanguageData.VUIP.SetDefaultAssignmentsTip: Make this pawn's assignments (hostility response, medical care, policies and carried items) the default for pawns that join the colony.
LanguageData.VUIP.ClearDefaultAssignmentsTip: These are the default assignments for new pawns. Click to clear them.
LanguageData.VUIP.DefaultAssignmentsSet: {0}'s assignments are now the default for new pawns.
LanguageData.VUIP.EnableNewGameDefaults: "Set as default" on storyteller and world pages
LanguageData.VUIP.EnableNewGameDefaultsTip: Adds a Set as default button to the storyteller and world generation pages when starting a new game. Saved choices are filled in the next time you start a colony. The world seed is never saved.
LanguageData.VUIP.SetStorytellerDefaultTip: Save the storyteller, difficulty (including custom difficulty settings) and reload-anytime or commitment mode as the default for new games.
LanguageData.VUIP.SetWorldDefaultTip: Save planet coverage, rainfall, temperature, population, pollution, landmarks, factions, map size and starting season as the default for new games. The seed stays random.
LanguageData.VUIP.ChooseDifficultyFirst: Choose a difficulty before saving it as the default.
LanguageData.VUIP.NewGameDefaultsSaved: Saved as the default for new games.
LanguageData.VUIP.SetQuestRewardDefaultsTip: Save the current Accept goodwill and Accept honor choices by faction type and apply them when factions are created in future games.
LanguageData.VUIP.QuestRewardDefaultsSaved: Saved quest reward preferences as the default for future games.
LanguageData.VUIP.SortScenarioListByTechLevelTip: Sorts scenarios low-tech to high-tech instead of vanilla's arbitrary order.
LanguageData.VUIP.ColorScenarioListByTechLevelTip: Adds a thin colored bar next to each scenario showing the tech level of its starting faction, so the list reads at a glance.
LanguageData.VUIP.KeybindsSectionTip: Custom keyboard shortcuts added by Vanilla UI+, and a shortcut to the game's keybinding settings.
LanguageData.VUIP.KeybindsResetTip: Restore keybind options to their defaults. Does not change the key assigned in the game's keybinding settings.
LanguageData.VUIP.EnableUnforbidAllHotkeyTip: Press the "Unforbid all" key (Home by default; change it in the game's keybinding settings) to unforbid every forbidden item on the current map.
LanguageData.VUIP.UnforbidAllHandledByOtherMod: {0} is active and already provides this shortcut, so Vanilla UI+'s own "Unforbid all" hotkey is disabled to avoid a conflict.
LanguageData.VUIP.EnableTemperatureOverlayHotkeyTip: Press the "Toggle temperature overlay" key (Backslash by default; change it in the game's keybinding settings) to toggle the vanilla temperature overlay on the current map.
LanguageData.VUIP.TemperatureOverlayHandledByHeatMap: Heat Map is active and already provides this shortcut, so Vanilla UI+'s own temperature overlay hotkey is disabled to avoid a conflict.
LanguageData.VUIP.EnableDevModeHotkeyTip: Press the "Toggle development mode" key (Numpad Minus by default; change it in the game's keybinding settings) to switch development mode on or off.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarTip: Drag a row to reorder, including the More button. Click the icon to change it. Icon / Both / Text set how it draws. Bar / More / Hide set where it appears. Hidden tabs and tabs in More keep their hotkeys.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarIconTip: Click to choose this button's icon.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarOnBarTip: Keep this tab on the main bar.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarDropdownTip: Move this tab into the More menu.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarHiddenTip: Hide this tab from the bar. Its hotkey still works.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarShowTip: Put this tab back on the main bar.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarMoreTip: Tabs moved off the main bar.
LanguageData.VUIP.MainBarMoreRowTip: The More overflow button. Drag it to place it among the other tabs. It only appears when at least one tab uses More.
LanguageData.VUIP.EnabledTip: When off, the right-side HUD (alerts, letters, date, weather, speed controls, and play buttons) uses vanilla drawing so you can compare. This does not turn the whole mod off. Custom notifications, the bottom main menu bar, and other Vanilla UI+ options still apply. Hostiles present moves back into the normal alert stack instead of being pinned. No restart needed.
LanguageData.VUIP.SnoozeDaysTip: Right-clicking an alert hides every alert of that type for this many in-game days. Custom alerts are snoozed by their label. Right-clicking requires the custom HUD; existing snoozes still apply without it.
LanguageData.VUIP.HideLockedResearchBenchAlert: Hide research bench alert until unlocked
LanguageData.VUIP.HideLockedResearchBenchAlertTip: Vanilla warns that you have no research bench even when research has not made one buildable yet. This hides that alert until at least one research bench is unlocked. Without mods that gate the bench behind research this changes nothing, since the simple research bench needs no research.
LanguageData.VUIP.EnableSnoozeTip: Lets you right-click an alert to hide every alert of that type for a set number of in-game days. Snoozes are saved with the world. When off, existing snoozes are ignored rather than deleted, so turning this back on restores them. Use Clear snoozes to remove them for good.
LanguageData.VUIP.WrapTextTip: When off (default), each alert is one line with an ellipsis. When on, long labels wrap inside the same-width bar.
LanguageData.VUIP.WrapLetterTextTip: When off (default), each letter is one line with an ellipsis. When on, long letter titles such as "Quest active: ..." wrap onto more lines so the whole title can be read.
LanguageData.VUIP.ReverseOrderTip: Puts letters above alerts and flips both stacks. Newest letters sit toward the top, and critical alerts sit closer to the HUD.
LanguageData.VUIP.BarOpacityTip: How dark the bars behind alerts, letters, and the right-side HUD are. Zero hides the bars.
LanguageData.VUIP.HudWidthTip: How wide the right-side HUD bars (alerts, letters, time speed, date, temperature) are.
LanguageData.VUIP.ColorTemperatureTip: Tints the temperature readout blue when cold, green in the human comfort band (about 16–26°C), and red when hot. This is not xenotype-aware.
LanguageData.VUIP.OutdoorTemperatureTip: When on (default), the readout shows the map's outdoor temperature. When off, it shows the temperature of the room under the mouse, like vanilla.
LanguageData.VUIP.ColorDayNightTip: Tints the clock amber in daylight and blue at night, fading through dusk and dawn. Useful for night owls.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowPreciseTimeTip: Shows the current in-game time to the minute instead of only the hour.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowColonyDayTip: Adds a Day x line under the date, counting how many days this colony has been running. The first day is Day 1.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowColonyWealthTip: Adds a wealth line under the date (or under colony day when that is shown). Uses the current map's wealth total.
LanguageData.VUIP.HideSpeedButtonsTip: Hides the pause and speed buttons. Space and the speed keys (1-4) still work.
LanguageData.VUIP.EventSpeedTip: When a raid or other event forces slowdown, this controls how fast the game still runs. Right-click the speed buttons for the same menu.
LanguageData.VUIP.SpeedFastTip: Tick multiplier for the second speed button.
LanguageData.VUIP.SpeedSuperfastTip: Tick multiplier for the third speed button.
LanguageData.VUIP.SpeedUltrafastTip: Tick multiplier for ultrafast. Always available, including without development mode.
LanguageData.VUIP.PlayButtonsTip: Click a button to show or hide it in the bottom-right bar. Dimmed buttons are hidden. Includes the Vanilla UI+ settings button. Extra buttons from other mods appear here after you've seen them in a game.
LanguageData.VUIP.ClearSnoozesNeedGame: Load a save to clear snoozes.
LanguageData.VUIP.SnoozeTip: Right-click to snooze this kind of alert for {0} days.
LanguageData.VUIP.BleedingOutDesc: These people will die from blood loss if they keep bleeding:\n\n{0}
LanguageData.VUIP.HostilesPresentDesc: These hostiles are on a map with your people:\n\n{0}
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowTraderPresentAlertTip: Alert while a trade caravan or orbital trade ship is still available. Orbital ships are only listed when you have a working comms console. Vanilla only sends a letter on arrival, which scrolls away while the trader is left waiting. Click to jump to the trader, or to the comms console for an orbital ship.
LanguageData.VUIP.ShowBatteriesLowAlertTip: Alert when a power grid is draining its batteries and is either below the charge threshold or close to running out. Grids that are charging are ignored. Click to jump to a battery.
LanguageData.VUIP.BatteryLowPercentTip: Warn when a draining grid holds less than this share of its total battery capacity.
LanguageData.VUIP.BatteryLowHoursTip: Warn when a draining grid has less than this many in-game hours of charge left at its current rate. Either threshold triggers the alert.
LanguageData.VUIP.BatteriesLowDesc: These power grids are draining their batteries:\n\n{0}
LanguageData.VUIP.TraderPresentDesc: These traders are here now and will leave in time:\n\n{0}
LanguageData.VUIP.TraderPresentOrbital: {0}, in orbit (trade using the comms console)
